"''If you're doing nothing wrong, what is there to fear?|Teenar and Slorda|audio=Teenar-Slorda-Narkina5.flac|}} '''Teenar''' was a [[human]] [[senator]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Senate]]. In [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|108}} a [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|rebel]] [[Aldhani heist|heist]] on the [[planet]]{{Andor|The Eye}} [[Aldhani]] prompted [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' to introduce the [[Public Order Resentencing Directive]]. Shortly after the new legislation was introduced, Teenar attended a party at the planet [[Coruscant]]'s [[Chandrilan Embassy]] where the [[Chandrilan]] Senator [[Mon Mothma]] attempted to gain votes against the directive. At the embassy, Teenar spoke with Mothma, Senators [[Vivyn]] and [[Dhow]], and the guest [[Slorda]] about the directive. Believing that the Empire had introduced unlimited surveillance and prosecutions, Teenar suggested Slorda calling Palpatine frustrating, overreactive, and easily provoked was an understatement and scoffed when Vivyn suggested they lived in dangerous [[time]]s. Teenar had [[Color|tan]] skin, brown [[eye]]s, and gray [[hair]]. The senator wore a set of brown and yellow [[Clothing|robes]] and a matching [[hat]] to the party. ==Behind the scenes== Teenar was portrayed by [[Anil Goutam]] in "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]," the eighth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which was aired on [[October 26]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}} The character's name is not spoken in the episode but is given in the subtitles and credits. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Teenar|soundcat=Audio files of Teenar}} *{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Teenar |ka=ტინარი |pl=Teenar }} [[Category:Galactic Empire senators]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
